english.title: Fail to give owners name and address and produce insurance - public place
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence, in a public place namely, **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to give the name and address of the owner of the vehicle, and to produce for examination the relevant certificate of insurance under Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) For the offence wording of failing to give the owners name, address and produce insurance in relation to driving a motor vehicle in a ROAD see H100104.
(ii) This offence wording relates to motor vehicles other than invalid carriages.
(iii) This offence was extended to include 'other public place' by the The Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) Regulations 2000 - S.I. 726/2000 refers.
(iv) Until 1st November 2021, securities or deposits could be used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. For offences before that date, see H65
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) when an accident occurred owing its presence on **(..SPECIFY THE PUBLIC PLACE AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to give the name and address of the vehicle's owner to a police constable when requested to do so and failed to produce for examination a relevant insurance certificate in respect of the vehicle, when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.
